typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	last_update_datetime as string
}
source(output(
		Process as string,
		LastUpdateDatetime as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['acf_metadata.csv']) ~> source1
source1 derive(LastUpdateDatetime = $last_update_datetime) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	input(
		{FileNamePrefix|CadenceExpected|ExpectedTime|EmailAlertsTo|SalesforceObject|Operation|PipelineName} as string
	),
	partitionFileNames:['acf_metadata.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> UpdateMetadata
source1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('acf_metadata_', replace(regexReplace($last_update_datetime, `[-:]`, ''), ' ', '_'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> ArchiveMetadata
